user.title: Connect to the UniFi 5G modem
user.description:
Home Assistant connects to the modem itself over SSH, so it needs the modem's address and the Device SSH login.

**Modem IP address**: UniFi Network → UniFi Devices → your 5G modem → Overview → IP Address. On a UniFi gateway the modem usually sits on an internal network that is routed from the LAN.

**Device SSH username**: UniFi Network → UniFi Devices → Device Updates and Settings (bottom left) → Device SSH Settings → Device SSH Authentication (Settings → System → Advanced → Device Authentication on UniFi Network older than 9.2.87). Turn it on there if it is off.

Leave the private key empty to let Home Assistant generate one; the next step shows the public key to add in UniFi.

authorize.title: Authorise the key
authorize.description:
Add this public key in UniFi Network → UniFi Devices → Device Updates and Settings (bottom left) → Device SSH Settings → SSH Keys, wait until the modem is provisioned (about a minute), then submit.

`{public_key}`

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the modem
reauth_confirm.description:
The modem rejected the connection. Make sure this public key is still listed in UniFi Network → UniFi Devices → Device Updates and Settings (bottom left) → Device SSH Settings → SSH Keys:

`{public_key}`

Tick the box only if the modem was replaced or reset and its host key changed on purpose.

reconfigure.title: Change the modem connection
reconfigure.description:
Use this when the modem's IP address or the Device SSH username changed. The key stays the same and must remain in UniFi Network → UniFi Devices → Device Updates and Settings (bottom left) → Device SSH Settings → SSH Keys:

`{public_key}`

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the modem over SSH.
error.invalid_auth: The modem rejected the key. Is it added to Device SSH keys and provisioned?
error.host_key_changed: The modem presented a different host key than the one stored.
error.invalid_key: The private key could not be read.
error.not_a_u5g: Connected, but the device did not answer like a UniFi 5G modem.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different modem than the configured one.

data.recipients: Default recipients for the notify entity

data_description.recipients: E.164 numbers separated by commas, e.g. +48123456789.
data_description.iccid: Leave empty to use the active SIM.
data_description.trusted_senders: E.164 numbers separated by commas. Incoming SMS get the attribute `trusted`; use it in automations that act on SMS commands.
data_description.only_trusted: Untrusted SMS do not fire events and do not update the last SMS sensor.
data_description.daily_limit: Maximum SMS parts sent per day, 0 = no limit. Each 64-byte part counts as one SMS.
data_description.ascii_only: Turns zażółć into zazolc. Every character then takes one byte, so more text fits in one SMS.

error.invalid_number: Use E.164 numbers with a country code, e.g. +48123456789.
error.trusted_required: Add at least one trusted sender or turn off ignoring other senders.

no_recipients.message: No recipients. Set default recipients in the integration options or pass `to`.

pick_entry.message: Pass config_entry_id: there is not exactly one loaded UniFi 5G SMS entry.

daily_limit.message: Daily SMS limit reached: {sent} of {limit} sent today, this message needs {needed}.

send.name: Send SMS
send.description: Send an SMS through the modem. Texts longer than 64 bytes go out as several messages.

to.name: To
to.description: E.164 number or a list of numbers.

config_entry_id.name: Modem
config_entry_id.description: Needed only with more than one modem.
